Integration tests cover all boundary responses and npm run validate plus a fresh verifier pass without changing finance contracts or calculations.
tasks.notes: Completed: malformed JSON -> stable 400 invalid_json, >32KB -> 413 request_too_large, unknown routes -> JSON 404, and X-Powered-By disabled. Fresh verifier PASS after logging-evidence fix. No finance/domain/persistence contract changes or new dependencies.

tasks.title: Enforce the full validation gate on GitHub changes
acceptanceCriteria: A least-privilege GitHub Actions workflow runs on main pushes and pull requests and may also be dispatched manually.

The job checks out code and configures Node through immutable official action commit hashes, installs from package-lock.json with npm ci, installs Chromium system dependencies, and runs npm run validate unchanged.
Workflow concurrency cancels superseded runs, a finite timeout prevents stuck jobs, and no secret, write permission, deployment, publication, or remote mutation is introduced.

Executable policy tests protect the workflow triggers, permissions, immutable actions, deterministic install, browser prerequisites, and single validation command; npm run validate and a fresh verifier pass.
